info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete Partner By Accesskey Id-spec
info.description: This API enables the deletion of partner records using a specified access key ID. Typically utilized by system administrators or integration platforms, this operation aids in maintaining a clean database by removing outdated or inactive partner associations. The /v5/aggregation/partners/accesskey/{accesskeyId} endpoint allows users to provide an access key identifier to effectively target and delete the corresponding partner record. This feature is essential for managing partner relationships and ensuring data integrity within the system.

delete.description: This operation allows you to delete a specific access key identified by its ID from the system. It is important to ensure that the access key is no longer needed before deletion, as this action cannot be undone.

requestBody.description: Request body to delete the specified access key. This operation permanently removes the access key identified by the provided ID.

DeletePartnerByAccesskeyIdRequest.description: The access key for partner operations, used in DELETE requests.
